_design: Execution backlog for the capability model (Layer 15). Model is BUILT now; execution is DEFERRED (user s079: 'creemos el modelo, luego los ejecutamos'). Each task is FULLY SPECIFIED — what to extract/run, from which system, and WHAT TO LOOK FOR — so later execution is turnkey, not rediscovery. Two types: EXTRACTION (needs SAP pull/run) and ANALYSIS (doable from data we hold). Provenance: code/structure system-invariant -> D01; production data -> P01 (currently inactive).
_status_legend: DEFERRED = defined, not started. Pick up when executing.

_execution_sequence_s079.rule: The research (wwrqcozf1) runs ALONE (serial). NOTHING else fires until it CLOSES. Then execute the steps below in order, autonomously, no per-step asking (user s079).
_execution_sequence_s079.GATE: wwrqcozf1 CLOSED. A,B,C DONE. B2 scheduling = SessionStart daily curation (native hook, no schtasks). D SKIPPED by user (s079) - stays deferred. E maturity current. F commit = pending user OK (focused, not blanket - git status has ~100 unrelated changes).

B. MEMORY/CONTINUITY impl (the 'stay+borrow', from the playbook): B1 tiered loading (lean L1 index at bootstrap + drill via graph_queries — the 400K-token fix); B2 scheduled curation (dreaming emulation as a scheduled task/skill). (auto-load already hardened s079.)

C. DOMAIN-ENRICHMENT pass (propagate verified findings into companions + domain .md, cross-reference rule): C1 Procurement/P2P as-is doc (OCEL2+conformance); C2 Treasury (file I/O + BAM readiness); C3 Payment (conformance + SoD); C4 each companion gets a capability-maturity section; C5 NEW Security domain from the verified AUTH/SoD method.

F. COMMIT (durability): git commit the model+research in BOTH repos — abapobjectscreation (CLAUDE.md, settings.json, capability_model/, research/) + ecosystem-coordinator (session-start.md, priority-actions.md).

extraction_tasks.caveat: Our CORE prod read tool is RFC_READ_TABLE over SNC SSO (how the whole Gold DB was built). It reads every field type EXCEPT STRING: the flat WA buffer can't serialize STRG. EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED s080 — all four RFC table readers (standard RFC_READ_TABLE, BBP_RFC_READ_TABLE, /SAPDS/RFC_READ_TABLE2, custom Z_RFC_READ_TABLE) return FM_OUTPUT/ONAME/OTEXT and SILENTLY OMIT ODESC (meta doesn't even list it; ODESC-alone -> TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA). This is a field-type limit of RFC, NOT an SSO/auth issue and NOT a tooling regression — ODESC is simply the first STRG column we've needed; no prior extracted column was STRING. We do NOT use ADT against production to read data. Excel is NOT a source.
